packageRules.description: Kotlin is governed by AGP 9's built-in Kotlin (KGP 2.2.10), not Renovate. The kotlinVersion pin in src/BlazorNative.Jni/build.gradle.kts must equal AGP's bundled KGP - a stdlib ahead of the compiler fails the android-build check (see #77). Bump Kotlin only in lockstep with an AGP upgrade whose built-in KGP moves.

The release-notes parse guard in scripts/commit-parse-check (#302) must run the exact release-please that the SHA-pinned googleapis/release-please-action bundles. action-version.json records it, measured from the action's own lockfile, and ReleaseParserVersionPinTests holds package.json and package-lock.json to it. An independent npm bump can never be correct, so Renovate does not offer one. The version moves only with a release-please-action bump: re-measure as action-version.json's $doc says, then update actionSha, releasePlease, conventionalCommitsParser, package.json and package-lock.json together.
